title: Meaningful Use Primer and Meaningful Use Core training modules
titleTag: Meaningful Use Primer and Meaningful Use Core training modules
description: We are happy to announce for a limited time that our Meaningful Use Primer training module can be added to your course library FREE of charge.
body:
Anyone who is involved with the delivery of patient care for a provider who participates in the Medicare or Medicaid incentive programs plays an important role in the Meaningful Use process. Some employees may only need an overview of Meaningful Use, while others may require a greater understanding of Meaningful Use.

To help you organization, we have developed two additional modules available in our course library:

  • The Meaningful Use Primer training module takes a closer look at the history of meaningful use, meaningful use terminology, an introduction to Stage 1 and Stage 2 Meaningful use, an introduction to Clinical Quality Measures (CQMs), and more. This course is available starting 9/9/2015.
  • The Meaningful Use Core training module modules is a more in depth look at Meaningful Use that also covers core objective, menu objectives, CQM reporting requirements, audits, penalties, and more. This course will be available within the next few weeks.

We are happy to announce for a limited time that our Meaningful Use Primer training module can be added to your course library FREE of charge.

If you would like to add the Meaningful Use Primer training module to your account, or if you would like more information about our Meaningful Use Core training module, please feel free to send us an email [email protected] .com or reach us by phone toll-free 855-427-0427 .
